title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-12-23
lineage: SBD > MR > R > DAT > CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with crystal‑clear vocals and a classic Uncle John's Band, highlighted by a fiery Me & My Uncle performance.
ai_review.review: The snippet offers an exceptionally clean soundboard capture – crisp instruments, lush room reverb and standout vocal clarity. Musically the set is solid, featuring a classic Uncle John's Band and a hot Jerry Garcia solo on Me & My Uncle, though the incomplete nature of the source leaves listeners wanting the full show.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3 stars; most comments praise both sound quality and performance, with only mild criticisms about incompleteness, yielding a strong positive overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good to perfect sound for the era – crisp mix, excellent vocal presence, pleasing room reverb; occasional low placement of Garcia on Hard to Handle but overall balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tasty overall performance but the snippet is incomplete; setlist confusion noted, yet the material presented flows well and keeps interest.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great picking on Me & My Uncle; a bit low in the mix on Hard to Handle but otherwise solid tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Driving bass force throughout; praised for strong presence (even noted on four‑string bass in some comments).
